d: Thailand’s tourism industry is losing its magic. Foreign visitor arrivals have fallen 4.6% in the first ten months of the year, putting the country on course for a second consecutive annual decline outside the pandemic. Once a favourite destination for Chinese and Malaysian tourists, Thailand is now facing falling arrivals, safety concerns, flooding and growing competition from neighbours such as Vietnam. In this video, Firstpost examines why travellers are looking elsewhere, how flight disruptions and rising costs are hurting the industry, and why tourism revenues are falling despite…
